name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5_Clinical-Trials_Matryoshka_final
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 2048). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (nomic_bert: BERT + rotary, GLU MLP)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. FULL fine-tune of nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (137M, identical tensor set, native 768 dim) with a MatryoshkaLoss wrapper over dims 768/512/256/128/64; the 5-dim ladder is the same checkpoint, not five models, and only the 768 rows are recorded here. Trained on vab46's own clinical-trials anchor/positive pairs. This card is unusual in the right way: it re-ran the BASE on the same corpus with the same InformationRetrievalEvaluator and printed base_value vs ft_value side by side, which is the comparison most embedding cards omit - so the +11.6pp accuracy@1 is a same-harness delta, not a cross-paper one. It is still a private in-domain corpus, not a BEIR task: expect the delta to shrink badly out of clinical trials. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-26.
